name: Bluebell Lodge
address: Bluebell Lodge, Old Dublin Road, Carlow, Co. Carlow
type: Detached period house with separate cottage
tagline: A period house with a separate three-bed cottage and mature gardens on the Old Dublin Road, a short walk from Carlow town centre.

pros.detail: The floor plan shows a separate one-level cottage with its own bedrooms and bathroom: a ready-made ground-floor home for the parents.

The walkable primaries are boys-only and DEIS: St Joseph's (juniors, 111) and Bishop Foley (seniors, 165), both with falling rolls; Scoil Mhuire Gan Smál is girls-only. Knockbeg (boys, 92% to third level) and Presentation Askea (mixed) are the strong secondaries.
On the Old Dublin Road at the edge of the centre: shops, GP, restaurants and the station without the car.
Carlow station is in town; about 10 trains a weekday to Heuston, roughly 1h05–1h20.
Gables, tall windows, ceiling plasterwork and fireplaces; sitting room, dining room, kitchen and conservatory downstairs.
A second dwelling is a real let; a B&B called Bluebell Lodge Townhouse is listed on this road, so ask whether this was it.

cons.detail: €100k above the ideal, though inside the near-a-train allowance. Stamp duty about €6,000.
Site size isn't stated; 'mature gardens' on a town road is unlikely to approach the 1 acre the dogs want.

cons.text: Floor area, BER and heating not stated
cons.detail: BER pending. No m² for either building, so the 140–280 m² test can't be checked yet.
Nearest 24-hour EDs are St Luke's Kilkenny or Portlaoise, each roughly 40 km; Naas (about 50 km) is adults only.
Aerials show schools, car parks and estates around it and the railway behind; no open land nearby. Check traffic, school-run congestion and train noise.
Period house plus cottage; budget a survey of both roofs, windows and services.
